statement.title: From questions to answers that change the world
statement.body: The School of Mechanical Engineering at Yonsei University combines the depth of basic science with engineering imagination to shape the future of energy, robotics, bio, and manufacturing. Beyond the boundaries of classroom and lab, every student grows into an engineer who takes on real-world problems.

bandEducation.title: Education that bridges theory and practice
bandEducation.body: A step-by-step curriculum that layers design, experiments, and projects on top of solid fundamentals — so graduates are ready to perform in the field from day one.

bandResearch.body: Labs in energy, robotics, biomechanics, and precision manufacturing produce results that draw the attention of international academia and industry.

intro.title: Welcome to <nb>Mechanical Engineering</nb>
intro.body: The School of Mechanical Engineering at Yonsei University delivers world-class education and research across a broad spectrum of fields — mechanics and materials, energy and thermo-fluids, robotics and control, design and manufacturing, micro/nano engineering, and bio-photonics. Grounded in creative thinking and a pioneering spirit, we cultivate engineers with integrated design capabilities who create value for the global society.

dean.title: Message from the Chair
dean.body: Mechanical engineering has tangibly transformed human life. Even amid a changing era, the School of Mechanical Engineering at Yonsei University will nurture talents who boldly challenge the future on an unshakeable foundation. We ask for your continued interest and support.
